nombre: Los Guardianes de la Ceiba · 2D plano preescolar (guía del cliente)
descripcion_en: 2D flat vector children's cartoon for ages 3 to 8, thick clean uniform dark outlines, soft cel shading with two tones only, no texture, oversized head, small rounded body, huge glossy eyes with a single white highlight, simple rounded shapes, mitten-like simple hands, no teeth, minimal nose, preschool animation style, warm, friendly and huggable, bright clear colors, high contrast silhouette.
negativo: Avoid: realistic or 3D rendering, photo style, anime style, fur, feather or fabric texture, gradients, sharp teeth, claws, weapons, scary or angry expressions, dark horror lighting, extra fingers, extra limbs, text, letters, numbers, captions, watermark, logos, busy background, extra characters that were not described, any change to the characters' faces, proportions, outfits or colors, cropped bodies, resemblance to famous cartoon characters or studios.
